memory_update.text: ALAB should remain the reference pure-play for AI fabric merchant connectivity, but its high attention level means it is less useful for underfollowed discovery except as a benchmark.
CRDO is a high-priority underfollowed-lane candidate for AECs, SerDes, DSPs, and hyperscale AI interconnect attach-rate diligence.

node: AI fabric interconnect silicon and board-level connectivity
summary: Expanded the US-listed universe around scarce AI fabric plumbing: merchant connectivity silicon, PCIe/CXL retimers, active electrical cables, copper/optical signal-integrity chips, and switch-adjacent interconnect components. The reference anchor is Astera Labs because it is the cleanest public pure-play in AI connectivity. The underfollowed lane emphasizes Credo, MACOM, and Semtech as narrower suppliers whose exposure may sit one or two steps away from GPUs and Ethernet switch headlines. No buy/sell view is implied.
